_about: What verify/from-json.js cannot fill mechanically for basic-bitch, written by hand and read by it on every run (from-json.js --write gives the same data.js again). gists: a stratagem's one-line summary (the app's own words: its EFFECT shortened, its WHEN/TARGET condition kept, nothing added), AI-written (Claude, 1 Nov 2026) with the fingerprint (gistOf) of the text it was written from, so a changed source text fails the gate's fingerprints step. units: per unit entry, GW's Faction Pack words where Wahapedia's transcription of an ability differs (texts), GW's FAQs and notes on its abilities (notes), and why (the reasons for what the list shows). Each is a judgement verify/helpers.js lists for sign-off.

invasion-fleet/rapid-regeneration.gist: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selected your TYRANIDS unit as a target: until the end of the phase, its models have Feel No Pain 6+ (5+ if it is within Synapse Range of your army).

invasion-fleet/adrenal-surge.gist: Fight phase, up to two TYRANIDS units from your army within Synapse Range of your army and eligible to fight (or one other eligible TYRANIDS unit): until the end of the phase, their attacks score a Critical Hit on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+.

invasion-fleet/death-frenzy.gist: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selected your TYRANIDS unit as a target: until the end of the phase, each time a model in it that has not fought this phase is destroyed, on a 4+ it is not removed yet: it can fight after the attacking unit has finished its attacks, then it is removed from play.

invasion-fleet/overrun.gist: Fight phase, just before your TYRANIDS unit Consolidates: until the end of the phase, its models can move an additional 3" when it Consolidates, if it can end that move within Engagement Range of an enemy unit; within Synapse Range of your army and not within Engagement Range of any enemy unit, it can make a Normal move of up to 6" instead.

invasion-fleet/predatory-imperative.gist: Your Command phase, up to two TYRANIDS units from your army within Synapse Range of your army (or one other TYRANIDS unit): select one more Hyper-adaptation, active for them until the start of your next Command phase; not the one selected at the start of the first battle round.

invasion-fleet/endless-swarm.gist: Your Command phase, up to two ENDLESS MULTITUDE units from your army within Synapse Range of your army (or one other ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit): return up to D3+3 destroyed models to each of them.

the-swarmlord-tyrant-guard.why: The Swarmlord leads the Tyrant Guard (the export’s association; LEADER on both GW datasheets: The Swarmlord can be attached to TYRANT GUARD). Malign Presence: GW’s Faction Pack Tyranids 1.3 words (Rules Updates, Change to), as the Swarmlord’s datasheet row has them for Healybois and Nidzillas (Wahapedia still prints the codex’s “If this model is your WARLORD …”); its Designer’s Note as the row has it (review result-healybois.json 89f3b0c37fbaa625).

Malign Presence.from: If this model is your **WARLORD**, each time your opponent targets a unit from their army with a **Stratagem**, if that unit is within 12" of this model, increase the cost of that use of that Stratagem by 1CP.
Malign Presence.to: Once per turn, when your opponent targets a unit from their army within 12" of this model with a **stratagem**, you can use this ability. If you do increase the CP cost of that use of that **stratagem** by 1CP.
Malign Presence.why: GW Faction Pack Tyranids 1.3, Rules Updates: "The Swarmlord, Malign Presence Ability. Change to: 'Once per turn, when your opponent targets a unit from their army within 12" of this model with a stratagem, you can use this ability. If you do increase the CP cost of that use of that stratagem by 1CP.'" (Wahapedia still prints the codex's words; the datasheet row has the pack's)

notes.Malign Presence: Designer’s Note (Wahapedia’s datasheet, under the codex wording): “This ability takes precedence over the Lord of Deceit ability presented in the Balance Dataslate June 2024.”

hive-tyrant-tyrant-guard.why: The Hive Tyrant leads the other Tyrant Guard (the export’s association; LEADER on both GW datasheets); no enhancement, 195 + Tyrant Guard 170. Will of the Hive Mind: GW’s Faction Pack Tyranids 1.3 words (“that use of”), as the Hive Tyrant’s datasheet row has them (Wahapedia: “that usage of”).

Will of the Hive Mind.why: GW Faction Pack Tyranids 1.3, Rules Updates: "Hive Tyrant, Winged Hive Tyrant – Will of the Hive Mind Ability. Change to: '… If it does, reduce the CP cost of that use of that Stratagem by 1CP.'" (Wahapedia: "that usage of that")

tyranid-prime-with-lash-whip-hormagaunts.why: Two units, each a Tyranid Prime with Lash Whip leading 20 Hormagaunts (the export’s associations; GW’s LEADER: HORMAGAUNTS among the units it can be attached to), copies:2, 75 + Hormagaunts 120 (GW: 20 models 120). Alpha Warrior gives every weapon of the unit [SUSTAINED HITS 1] (BSData’s modifier, New Recruit shows it; marked).

notes.Seed Spore Mines: FAQ (Faction Pack 1.3): “When my Biovores unit uses the Seed Spore Mines ability, does my unit lose hidden?” “No.” FAQ (Faction Pack 1.3): “Are Spore Mines units that are added to an army during a battle restricted by abilities that prevent Reserves from being set up within a certain range (e.g. Space Marines Infiltrators’ Omniscrambers)?” “No.”

biovores.why: One Biovore (60 pts). Seed Spore Mines: 8" as GW’s Faction Pack Tyranids 1.3 (Rules Updates: “Change 9" to 8".”), as BSData and Wahapedia have it. The SPORE MINES unit it adds is the reference sheet Spore Mines (Biovore) (New Recruit’s reference entry).

spore-mines-biovore.why: Reference sheet: New Recruit’s “Spore Mines (Biovore)” entry (0 pts, 1 Spore Mine), GW’s Spore Mines datasheet; not in the army until the Biovores’ Seed Spore Mines adds a SPORE MINES unit (“That SPORE MINES unit contains 1 model for each model in this unit”: one, for one Biovore).

tyrannofex.why: Tyrannofex with Stinger salvoes and Acid spray: 170 + Acid spray 10 = 180 (GW: 1st to 2nd units 170; WARGEAR OPTIONS Acid spray +10).
